subject: stf
title: STF.------PRI.INFO.
description: Diagram in WI-26, the first of two on book p310. (C)STF (source transfer) is crossed with PRI-INFO (principle information). The diagram poses what source transfer requires when crossed with principle information. STF → PRI-INFO (the crossing). STF also branches to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) → LK-IMP (linkage implications); LK-IMP branches to MT-INFO (multi-information) and to AF-CON (affinity convergence) → POL-DYM (political dynamics) → TM (terminology—or terms of a definition). A third branch runs STF → CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) → RE-ST (restructuralism) → IST-F (isolated focus).
